task.title: P6-152: Fix two batch-move gaps: stale ownership block and wrong empty-state string
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Selection tray and batch move). Original id: P6-152. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Two small batch-move gaps** (was `P6-061e` + `P6-061f`): `HoldingsRevision` is consumed only by `/my` and `/my/collections/:id`, so `/cards/:oracle`'s ownership block is **not** invalidated by a move; and the tray picker passes `empty="No collection to move to."` into `CommandEmpty`, so that string also appears when a *search* filters every row out (the catalog says "No collection matches." there) — an instance of `P6-011`.
